$comment: ProviderCapabilitySnapshot vectors (contracts/schemas/provider-capability-snapshot.schema.json). 'valid' cases must validate and must round-trip through each SDK's generated type without gaining or losing a key — in particular, an absent streamingAvailable or cancellationAvailable stays absent, because absent means 'inherit the static declaration' and is a distinct state. 'invalid' cases must be rejected at the given path. Loaded by packages/contracts/src/validators.test.ts and ios/IndeRun/Tests/IndeRunTests/ProviderCapabilitySnapshotTests.swift.

valid.description: A cloud provider that declares streaming; both tri-state booleans are absent and inherit.
A local provider whose host takes streaming away and cannot honour cancellation right now.

capabilities.streamingUnavailableReason: This provider does not implement streaming.

valid.description: A platform model that is not available on this host.

capabilities.reason: The browser exposes no built-in model.

valid.description: A speech provider that declares per-task capabilities and reports its voices dynamically.

ADR 025: declared controls; live states keyed by id and delivery, with a narrower rate range for artifacts than for playback; and sparse per-voice overrides on the en-GB voice (pitch disabled on playback, artifact rate narrowed further). Every other pair inherits the task's state.

invalid.description: null is not a fourth state of the tri-state boolean.
transport is part of the static declaration.
Output delivery is a closed set.
ADR 025: control ids are a closed set.
ADR 025: a playback-phase control lists only the playback delivery.
ADR 025: playback.volume is a playback-phase control.
ADR 025: speech.speakingRate is a synthesis-phase control.
ADR 025: the shared controls take a number.
ADR 025: speech controls never apply to inline text output.
ADR 025: a control state names the delivery it describes.
ADR 025: playback.volume only has a playback state.
ADR 025: a range names min and max.
ADR 025: available is true, false or absent, never null.
